title: STS2 AI Agent
changeNote: v0.16.1: inviting an AI teammate now tells you why it failed. If you invite or continue a co-op run while in solo mode or while auto-play is running, the request used to sit at "inviting..." forever with no window, no message, and no log. It now returns a clear reason and the overlay says what to change first. Nothing changes for your runs: no cards, no numbers, no saves are touched.
